title: Appeals and Grievances Tier Schedule: Subjects, Levels and Review Basis
content:
The six tiers of Appeals and Grievances at Westbridge Military Health Services each hear a defined kind of subject, sit at a defined appeal level and re-examine a defined matter. The tier schedule below is the reference for every tier; each column restates one schedule entry.

**Schedule entries in this part**

- *Appealable subjects*: the kinds of subject a case of the tier may be opened on.
- *Not appealable at this tier*: matters that cannot be decided by the tier and are dismissed as not appealable.
- *Appeal level*: the appeal level of the tier (0 means a review or grievance outside the appeal levels; 1 means the first level).
- *Review basis*: what the reviewer re-examines.
- *Grouping of lines*: how several lines or items of one determination are grouped into one case.
- *One open case per subject*: whether a second case on the same subject is refused while one is open.
- *Subject record held*: whether the subject record is held from further routine adjustment while the case is open.

| Tier | Appealable subjects | Appeal level | Review basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | the allowed amount set on a claim line (allowable charge) | 0 | the allowed-amount methodology for the service date and locality |
| Beneficiary Grievance | a service complaint | 0 | the service, access or conduct complained of |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | a claim line | 1 | the facts and benefit rules applied to the claim line |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | an enrollment disenrollment or termination | 0 | good cause for the missed payment and payment of past-due amounts |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | an authorization denial; a claim line | 1 | clinical records against medical necessity criteria |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | an authorization denial | 1 | clinical records against medical necessity criteria |

| Tier | Not appealable at this tier |
|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | DEERS eligibility determinations; provider network status; enrollment fee and premium amounts; coverage and medical necessity decisions |
| Beneficiary Grievance | DEERS eligibility determinations; provider network status; enrollment fee and premium amounts; any claim, authorization or enrollment determination |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | DEERS eligibility determinations; provider network status; enrollment fee and premium amounts; allowed-amount disputes; medical necessity decisions |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | DEERS eligibility determinations; provider network status; enrollment fee and premium amounts; disenrollments not for nonpayment |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | DEERS eligibility determinations; provider network status; enrollment fee and premium amounts; allowed-amount disputes; factual benefit exclusions |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | DEERS eligibility determinations; provider network status; enrollment fee and premium amounts; allowed-amount disputes; factual benefit exclusions |

| Tier | Grouping of lines | One open case per subject | Subject record held |
|---|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | lines of one claim with the same dispute may be grouped | yes | yes |
| Beneficiary Grievance | one case per complaint | yes | no |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | lines of one claim with the same denial reason may be grouped | yes | yes |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | one case per ended enrollment | yes | yes |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | lines of one claim with the same denial reason may be grouped | yes | yes |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | one case per authorization | yes | yes |

**Entry conditions of each tier, in tier order**

| Order | Tier | Entry condition |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Allowable Charge Review | subject is an allowable charge; filed within 90 days of the Explanation of Benefits |
| 2 | Beneficiary Grievance | subject is a service complaint |
| 3 | Claim Factual Reconsideration | subject is a claim line; filed within 90 days of the Explanation of Benefits |
| 4 | Enrollment Reinstatement Review | subject is an enrollment disenrollment; ended for nonpayment; filed within 90 days of the disenrollment |
| 5 | Medical Necessity Reconsideration | subject is an authorization denial or a claim line; denied as not medically necessary; filed within 90 days of the denial |
| 6 | Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | subject is an authorization denial; denied as not medically necessary; expedited criteria certified by the treating provider; filed within 3 days of the denial |

**Reading the schedule**

- A claim line can be the subject of a Claim Factual Reconsideration or a Medical Necessity Reconsideration; which one hears it depends on the review basis shown above, and allowed-amount disputes are not appealable at either of those two tiers.
- Only the Beneficiary Grievance leaves the subject record free for routine adjustment while the case is open; every other tier holds it.
